# Nested pair inputs, comparator and binary result

Independently authored Java8 declarations retain Collection<Map.Entry<K,V>>,
Comparator<Map.Entry<K,V>> and a LinkedHashMap<K,V> result. The frozen observer
checks exact entry/comparator references, iteration and comparison order,
entry key/value actions, opaque map identity, partial exceptions, alias/null
cases, ignored calls and the original provider cast. Source and SDK modes
compile every output and compare original metadata, roles, Exceptions and
helpers. No private application bytes or behavior are included.
